title: Chapter 3 Quiz 10
description: Repeating actions under the control of a condition, and where the condition is checked.
instructions: Take your time: read each question carefully, then check your answer.

questions.question: In a **While** loop, when is the condition checked?
options: Only at the end of the program
questions.explanation: The condition is checked before the actions, so they may never run.

questions.question: In a **Repeat...Until** loop, when is the condition checked?
questions.explanation: The condition is checked after the actions, so they run at least once.

questions.question: A While loop may never execute its actions.
questions.explanation: If the condition is false at the start, the actions are skipped.

questions.question: A Repeat...Until loop always executes its actions at least once.
questions.explanation: The test comes after the first pass.

questions.question: A While loop runs **as long as** its condition is…
questions.explanation: While = as long as true. Repeat...Until stops when the condition becomes true.

questions.question: A Repeat...Until loop stops when its condition becomes…
questions.explanation: The loop repeats until the condition is met, that is, true.

questions.question: Complete the loop that displays the numbers from 1 to 10.
questions.code:
Let i ← 1
{{1}} i <= 10
Do
    Display(i)
    i ← {{2}}
EndDo
questions.explanation: The loop runs while i <= 10. We must increase i, otherwise the loop never ends.
questions.hint: What must change on every pass?

questions.question: Complete the loop that repeats a calculation until the user types N.
questions.code:
Repeat
    Read(a, b)
    Let p ← a * b
    Display(p)
    Input(c)
{{1}} c {{2}} 'N'
questions.explanation: Repeat...Until c = 'N' stops when the user answers N.

questions.question: i ← 1. While i <= 10 Do ... i ← i + 1. How many times does the loop body run?
questions.explanation: i takes the values 1 to 10, that is 10 passes.

questions.question: i ← 1. While i < 10 Do Display(i); i ← i + 3 EndDo. How many values are displayed?
questions.explanation: i takes 1, 4, 7. Then i = 10, and 10 < 10 is false, so the loop stops. That is 3 values.
questions.hint: Write the values of i and check each against i < 10.

questions.question: A PIN checker repeats until the typed PIN equals the right PIN, and counts the trials. Which loop fits best, since the user must type at least once?
questions.explanation: The user must type at least once, which suits Repeat...Until.

questions.question: The right PIN is 1234. The user types 1111, 4321, 1234. Trace the loop.
questions.explanation: The counter goes up on every try. The loop stops on the third one.
